course_description: Professional nursing concepts, aseptic techniques, vital signs, medication administration, health assessment, wound care, and compassionate patient care.

course_outcomes.co_description: Apply nursing process and aseptic clinical techniques in patient assessment and health promotion.
Analyze human vital signs, physiological data, and diagnostic lab values to formulate nursing care plans.
Administer pharmacological treatments and demonstrate safe medication dosages under hospital protocols.
Evaluate patient outcomes, ethical dilemmas, and infection control compliance in clinical ward settings.
Formulate holistic, patient-centered nursing care plans integrating Perpetualite compassion and healthcare ethics.

weekly_schedule.topic: Orientation to Professional Nursing, Bioethics, and Health Care Systems

lesson_outcomes.description: Explain the scope of professional nursing practice and bioethics
Demonstrate clinical handwashing and basic aseptic technique
Embody the Perpetualite core value of compassionate service

weekly_schedule.topic: Vital Signs Assessment: Body Temperature, Pulse, and Respiration
weekly_schedule.teaching_learning_activity: Vital Signs Demonstration and Return Demonstration

lesson_outcomes.description: State normal physiological parameters across age cohorts
Measure and record pulse rates and respiratory patterns accurately
Value patient comfort and dignity during physical assessment

weekly_schedule.topic: Blood Pressure Measurement and Hemodynamic Monitoring

lesson_outcomes.description: Explain Korotkoff sounds and factors influencing vascular pressure
Execute accurate blood pressure measurement techniques
Demonstrate meticulous accuracy in recording clinical data

weekly_schedule.topic: Health Assessment: Head-to-Toe Physical Examination Techniques

lesson_outcomes.description: Describe inspection, palpation, percussion, and auscultation procedures
Perform systematic physical assessment across body systems
Respect patient privacy and cultural sensitivities

weekly_schedule.topic: Infection Control, Universal Precautions, and PPE Protocols
weekly_schedule.teaching_learning_activity: Sterile Field Setup & PPE Donning/Doffing Lab

lesson_outcomes.description: Explain chains of infection transmission and sterile barrier principles
Don and doff sterile gloves, masks, and protective gowns
Display diligence in preventing nosocomial pathogen transmission

weekly_schedule.topic: Preliminary Examination: Fundamental Nursing Theories & Clinical Skills Return Demo

lesson_outcomes.description: Recall anatomical landmarks and basic nursing intervention principles
Execute timed basic clinical skill return demonstrations
Exhibit professional composure and ethical demeanor under evaluation

weekly_schedule.topic: Nursing Process: Assessment, Nursing Diagnosis, and Care Planning

lesson_outcomes.description: Identify NANDA nursing diagnosis taxonomies and etiology statements
Formulate measurable short-term and long-term patient goals
Commit to individualized, compassionate patient care

weekly_schedule.topic: Medication Administration Foundations: The 10 Rights and Dosage Calculations

lesson_outcomes.description: Explain pharmacokinetics, drug classifications, and safety checks
Calculate metric dosages and intravenous drip rates without error
Uphold zero-tolerance for pharmacological administration errors

weekly_schedule.topic: Enteral and Topical Medication Delivery: Oral, Sublingual, and Transdermal

lesson_outcomes.description: Describe administration routes and absorption barriers
Administer oral medications following 10-rights safety protocols
Demonstrate empathy when addressing patient medication anxieties

weekly_schedule.topic: Parenteral Medication Delivery: Intramuscular, Subcutaneous, and Intradermal

lesson_outcomes.description: Identify correct injection sites, needle gauges, and penetration angles
Perform sterile intramuscular and subcutaneous injections
Provide reassuring patient communication during needle procedures

weekly_schedule.topic: Wound Care, Surgical Asepsis, and Sterile Dressing Changes

lesson_outcomes.description: Differentiate wound healing phases and exudate classifications
Execute sterile dressing change and wound cleansing procedures
Show meticulous patience in preserving sterile fields

weekly_schedule.topic: Midterm Examination: Clinical OSCE on Medication Administration and Wound Management

lesson_outcomes.description: Synthesize pharmacological safety rules and wound healing dynamics
Demonstrate flawless parenteral administration under inspection
Display professional accountability and nurse-patient rapport

weekly_schedule.topic: Intravenous (IV) Therapy: Cannulation, Fluid Maintenance, and Infiltration Monitoring

lesson_outcomes.description: Explain fluid and electrolyte balances and IV solution categories
Insert and secure intravenous cannulas under sterile conditions
Maintain constant vigilance for phlebitis and infiltration signs

weekly_schedule.topic: Oxygenation, Airway Management, and Tracheostomy Care
weekly_schedule.teaching_learning_activity: Airway Suctioning and Nebulization Practical Lab

lesson_outcomes.description: Describe pulse oximetry, respiratory mechanics, and hypoxia signs
Perform tracheostomy care and sterile endotracheal suctioning
Respond with calm urgency to acute respiratory distress indicators

weekly_schedule.topic: Pain Management, Patient Comfort Measures, and Palliative Nursing
weekly_schedule.teaching_learning_activity: Pain Assessment Scale and Comfort Measure Workshop

lesson_outcomes.description: Assess acute versus chronic pain using standardized clinical scales
Implement non-pharmacological comfort and repositioning interventions
Demonstrate deep empathy for patients enduring severe discomfort

weekly_schedule.topic: Perioperative Nursing: Pre-operative Preparation and Post-Anesthesia Recovery
weekly_schedule.teaching_learning_activity: Operating Room Protocols & Recovery Room Lab

lesson_outcomes.description: Outline surgical consent verification and recovery complications
Monitor post-operative vital signs and surgical wound drains
Prioritize patient safety during post-anesthetic transitions

weekly_schedule.topic: Comprehensive Clinical Nursing Integration and Interdisciplinary Ward Rounds

lesson_outcomes.description: Synthesize multi-system health alterations into prioritized actions
Collaborate with medical teams in simulated ward handovers (SBAR)
Demonstrate leadership and collaborative teamwork in nursing care

weekly_schedule.topic: Final Examination & Capstone Clinical Defense: Comprehensive Patient Care Evaluation
weekly_schedule.teaching_learning_activity: Formal Capstone Defense & Exit Clinical Exam

lesson_outcomes.description: Synthesize all theoretical nursing sciences and clinical proficiencies
Defend comprehensive evidence-based nursing care management plan
Exemplify Perpetualite 'Helpers of God' professional virtue
